title: Unified Cross-Disorder EEG Foundation Model (UC-EEG-FM): Benchmark Suite, Pretrained Weights, and Clinical Decision Support System
description: Official open-source benchmark repository and pre-trained weights for the Unified Cross-Disorder EEG Foundation Model (UC-EEG-FM). Contains standardized clinical datasets (Alcohol Use Disorder, Alzheimer's and Frontotemporal Dementia, Pediatric Epilepsy), Spatial-Temporal Transformer backbone, 64-dimensional unit hypersphere latent manifold embeddings across 49,472 epochs (54.97 hours), strict subject-stratified clinical benchmarking pipelines, few-shot transfer learning curves, gradient-weighted feature attribution saliency, and edge-deployable TorchScript and ONNX models.
